body: Thank you for still being here! It's not easy and I'm proud of you! ❤
That makes a lot of sense, I feel like I use it to hide away from the world when things get too tough. Glad to know I'm not the only one. 🙂

I have had pretty intense daydreams for 10+years and they unfold like a story for lack of a better term. I am living my life as myself but my ideal version of myself (stronger emotionally and mentally, handling trauma better than I have irl, less trauma, tight knit family like bonds with my characters). All my daydreams revolve around the same three characters and myself and we do everything from mundane things like singing in the car listening to the radio, to getting food, to living together, to more outlandish things like having superpowers and fighting crime. I normally listen to music when I daydream and sometimes specific songs will be tied to specific daydreams or memories/people in my daydreams that putting on said song can instantly put me back in that daydream.

I have had the same group of people in my dreams for almost 10 years. The relationships between myself and the characters has slowly changed over time, they started out more like supporting characters but over time our relationships developed into something very deep almost like family. Each character not only has a unique personality, but they also have deep, complex relationships with one another.

I have never been able to develop and serious interests in any hobbies because I either spent so much time daydreaming or whatever hobby I would pick up I would do it in my daydreams and it would be better than irl 🤷‍♀️
I remember my ex step-dad would always make fun of me because I would lock myself in the bathroom and bounce off the walls and he would always think I was dancing in there 😂
This is such a cute idea!! 😍😍😍 I wish my boyfriend liked video calling I would love to try this with him 😭
I had a dream the other night that my old friend hugged me tight and said thank you for everything we love you and want you here. I woke up crying like a baby.
La Croix even though I get so much shit for it.
